meaning_en: {where}: {term} is banned by draft rule {rule}, which the owner has not confirmed (not legal advice): {note}
meaning_zh: {where}：“{term}”触犯了规则草稿 {rule}（{note}）；该规则尚未经负责人确认，不构成法律意见

meaning_en: {where}: says {said} but {fact} is {value}, a value the owner has not confirmed yet
meaning_zh: {where}：说的是“{said}”，但 {fact} 是 {value}（该数值尚未经负责人确认）

meaning_en: Rule {rule}: {pattern} is not a valid regex ({error}); fix the rule file, nothing was linted
meaning_zh: 规则 {rule} 的正则 {pattern} 写错了（{error}）；请先修正规则文件，本次没有做检查

meaning_en: Rule {rule}: {column} {value} is not allowed ({allowed}); fix the rule file, nothing was linted
meaning_zh: 规则 {rule} 的 {column} 填了 {value}，不允许（应为 {allowed}）；请先修正规则文件，本次没有做检查
